Amanda (SRE): :warning: APAC alert — embed routes in apac-1 showing p95 ~2x since ~02:10 local. Customer ticket #24567. Any infra changes?

Raj (Infra): We rolled kernel + CUDA agent in the apac pool at 01:50 (auto rollout). Noticed a subset of nodes on CUDA 15.2 earlier this morning.

Mika (Eng-ML): Model-side metrics look steady (KV cache hit fine). Latency spike timeline aligns with increased iowait on those nodes.

Kai (Customer Success): Customer reports p95 jumps from ~350ms -> ~700ms for embeddings. They're on dedicated cluster apac-1 and seeing impact now.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0421-17 • Severity: High • Assigned: Amanda (SRE)

Amanda (SRE): Quick repro from inside apac-exec: 
`for i in {1..50}; do curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"text": "x" * 256}'; done`
With parallel=8 we hit p95 ~680ms on node-APAC-12, and top shows iowait ~35%.

Raj (Infra): grabbing NVMe and iostat info now — ssh'd into node-APAC-12. nvme smart shows elevated avg lat. Posting iostat shortly.

Raj (Infra): iostat -x 1 5 snapshot:
```
avg-cpu: %user %nice %system %iowait %steal %idle
           20.0   0.0   10.0    35.2    0.0   34.8
Device             r/s     w/s   rsec/s  wsec/s  avgrq-sz avgqu-sz await  svctm  %util
nvme0n1         120.00  60.00  4800    2400     60.00     3.8   25.1   0.6   66.0
```

Mika (Eng-ML): avgqu-sz 3.8 and await ~25ms — queue depth spike. Could be a concurrent io-heavy job (backups, GC) co-scheduled with inference.

Support Ops: Confirmed: nightly backup (rsync) jobs run on apac-1 nodes at 02:00 local by the ops group. That overlaps the CUDA rollout window.

Amanda (SRE): That timing smells like IO contention from backups + new driver scheduling behavior interacting with NVMe queueing. Need quick mitigation.

Kai (Customer Success): Customer can failover to us-east temporarily. Want an ETA for mitigation?

Mika (Eng-ML): Short-term mitigations we can try now: 1) cordon/drain hot node, 2) route traffic to apac-2 cold pool, 3) set cgroup blkio/io.weight for inference pods to higher priority, 4) mount with noatime on hot hosts.

Raj (Infra): Actioned: cordoned node-APAC-12 and drained inference pods -> rescheduled to apac-2. Flipped mount option noatime on repro nodes and switched scheduler from cfq to mq-deadline. Also applied blkio weight 100 for inference cgroup.

Amanda (SRE): After reschedule p95 for the repro runs dropped to ~220ms on apac-2. Customer confirmed improved latency :white_check_mark:. Keeping node cordoned until we have a stable plan.

Mika (Eng-ML): Logged an option to pin CUDA driver version and disable auto-update in our node image pipeline. PR opened: infra/disable-cuda-autoupdate.

Raj (Infra): Collecting artifacts for vendor: nvme logs, iostat, dmesg, system journal. Filing bug with vendor (NVME-7890) and attaching traces + repro steps.

Amanda (SRE): Immediate follow-ups: 1) update runbook to avoid overlapping driver rollouts with heavy backup windows, 2) add pre-rollout io-pressure check (avg iowait/avgqu-sz threshold), 3) consider sequencing kernel/driver updates per-AZ. I'll own the postmortem.

Kai (Customer Success): I'll update the customer and offer credit if they ask. Thanks team.

Support Ops: Note: we'll shift backup window for apac-1 and add a safety check to ops scheduler to avoid running rsync during infra rollouts.

Amanda (SRE): Filing this under INC-2026-0421-17 and starting postmortem doc. If anyone has additional logs or reproductions, paste here.

Raj (Infra): Uploaded dmesg + nvme logs to the incident folder: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-0421-17/artifacts

Mika (Eng-ML): Suggest we also add a perf test in canary that simulates small random i/o noise while running inference to catch these interactions in future.

Amanda (SRE): Agreed. Adding to action items. Closing urgent mitigation, moving to investigation phase. :lock:
